_comment: Model manifest for BiRefNet subject matting (DEC-031). Weights are vendored from the Hugging Face Hub via scripts/download_birefnet.py rather than a single-file URL; the pinned revision and weights checksum below are what that script verifies before use.
name: BiRefNet
description: General-purpose dichotomous image segmentation / matting transformer. Selected over the current MediaPipe selfie segmenter after a measured comparison (DEC-031) showed it correctly excludes background structures the selfie model absorbs into the subject mask, and over RMBG-2.0 (a retrain of this same architecture, CC BY-NC 4.0) and BEN2 (Apache-2.0, ONNX export) on both edge-alignment quality and speed.
_inference_input_size_note: BiRefNet accepts any square input; 512 was chosen after a resolution sweep showed it matches 1024's edge-alignment score and is visually indistinguishable while running ~7x faster on CPU (see DEC-031).
redistribution_notes: MIT licensed. Suitable for redistribution and commercial use. Weights are large (~424 MiB) and gitignored like the other model-assets entries; acquire with scripts/download_birefnet.py.
